notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome (Shopify store, robots.txt has no Claude-disallow: 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Allow:/'). Same-origin fetch() from the page context against /collections.json (limit=250, 2 pages) enumerated all 308 live collections on the store (up from 283 in the prior Home-Decor pass, confirming the store has grown since). Scanned every collection title+handle against a furniture keyword list (furniture, sofa, chair, table, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, stool, bench, dresser, shelv, bookcase, seating, nightstand, armchair, ottoman, pouf, recliner, sectional, console, sideboard, vanity, trolley, bar cart, rack, stand, almirah, swing, divan, etc.) and manually eyeballed the full alphabetical title list (308 entries) for anything missed. Store is overwhelmingly decor/tableware/candle/vase/bath/faux-leather-accessory focused; furniture is only a tiny side line, exactly as expected for this brand. Found: (1) a top-level 'Furniture' collection (handle /collections/furniture) that itself lists 0 products (page shows 'We couldn't find any Products for this Collection!' plus an unrelated decor fallback grid) but whose on-page marketing copy names three product types PHL sells as furniture: Pouffes, Side tables, Bar carts. (2) Of those three, only Pouffes actually exist as a live collection -- 'Faux Leather Pouffe' (handle faux-leather-pouffe), confirmed linked from the /collections/furniture page itself (a[href] scan). No side-table or bar-cart collection exists anywhere in the 308-collection list (checked handles/titles for side-table, side_table, bar-cart, bar_cart, trolley, nesting -- none found); those product types are apparently no longer sold or never had a dedicated collection, only mentioned in leftover SEO copy. (3) A stray 'Living Room' collection (handle living-room) also exists, decorated with a pouffe product image, but /products.json enumeration returns 0 real products despite collections.json's products_count field claiming 8 (another instance of the known-inflated Shopify products_count field) -- treated as a dead/orphan collection, not part of the real navigable tree, and not emitted as a row. (4) 'Office Collection' (candidate for office furniture) enumerated to 0 products -- confirmed empty, excluded. All other keyword hits (Candle Stands, Cookie Stand, Pen Stand, Table Accessories/Napkin, Tableware, Faux Leather Pen Stand/Storage Boxes/Pouffe-adjacent organisers) are decor/stationery/storage items per the project's storage-vs-furniture and standalone-storage exclusion rules, not furniture. For the one real leaf, Faux Leather Pouffe: /collections/faux-leather-pouffe/products.json enumerated 2 total product IDs ('Dark Grey Square Faux Leather Pouffe with Storage', 'Grey Square Faux Leather Pouffe with Storage'), but the rendered storefront page (get_page_text) shows a header reading '1 Products' and displays only the Grey variant -- the Dark Grey one is evidently out of stock and hidden from the live listing. Per brief Trap #4 (qty is an in-stock snapshot on stock-gated storefronts), the rendered header (1) was taken as qty, not the raw enumeration (2), and this discrepancy is flagged. This is a storage pouffe/ottoman -- explicitly in-scope furniture-typed seating per the brief (ottomans/poufs when filed as furniture/seating), and the site itself files it under its top-level Furniture department. No grouping row emitted for the top-level 'Furniture' node since it has exactly one direct child with no intermediate parent layer (category field already carries 'Furniture').
